2.title: さしすせそ・たちつてと

kana.intro: The s row and the t row. Three of them change their sound: shi, chi and tsu.

cards.note: shi, not si: before i, the s turns into sh.
chi, not ti: before i, the t turns into ch.
tsu, not tu: a t and an s said together.
